The '''Kaas City military police''' was a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] under the [[Sphere of Laws and Justice]] that was responsible for maintaining order in [[Kaas City]], the government center of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The police assisted the [[Imperial Guard|Dark Honor Guard]] in putting down the [[Purge of the Dark Council#Public unrest|Kaas City protests]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Eckard Lokin]] supposedly worked for the military police at some point as a [[Science and Medical Advisor]].
